messages:
leah: hey y'all, accepted the org invite but i can't see private repos or re-run CI, getting a 403.
ops-amy: @leah did you accept with your work account or a personal one?
leah: looks like personal (leah.dev@gmail.com). i have 2FA on that acct though.
devx-sam: SSO enrollment requires your work email to be on the GitHub account and 2FA enabled. If you used personal and didn't add the work email it won't map.
leah: ah — i didn't add maya@redwood.ai (wait wrong name) — my work email is leah@redwood.ai. i'll add it now.
it-bot: reminder: org requires SSO + 2FA. See onboarding docs: https://redwood.dev/onboard/github
leah: added and verified leah@redwood.ai, enabled TOTP. invite page still says "Team membership pending".
ops-amy: give me a minute, i'll trigger a manual SSO sync and queue you into eng, infra teams. if you need to re-run Actions i'll open a temp write grant.
ops-amy: sync done, invited to teams: eng, infra. granted temporary write to repo "platform-deploy" to allow CI rerun.
leah: reran job and it succeeded :tada: can now see private repos.
devx-sam: if you prefer to consolidate accounts later we can transfer any PRs or cherry-pick commits, but mapping kept your original author on the PR which is nicer.
leah: huge thanks. i'll add a quick intro in #new-hires-intros. also — where's the checklist for adding SSH keys?
devx-sam: see https://redwood.dev/onboard/ssh and ping me if the key upload shows a permission error.
leah: will do, thanks all!
